caption: The drawing depicts two human figures standing close together, positioned centrally on a plain, beige background. Both figures are dressed in long garments that reach their feet. The figure on the left wears a pale blue dress with greenish tones, a large, light gray collar, and a hat that is bluish with white accents. This figure also has reddish-brown hair and a visible face with distinct facial features. The figure on the right, who appears slightly in front of and to the right of the other figure, is wearing a long pink dress with hints of purple shading, and a grayish headpiece or hood. This figure's face is also visible and shows dark hair. Both garments have some textural detailing, with the hem of the blue dress having dark, possibly patterned fabric. The artistic technique uses soft washes of color primarily in blue, pink, green, gray, and some purple, and there is no background detail or objects besides the two figures. The rest of the composition is empty, with significant negative space surrounding the figures.
title: Rag Doll Nurse and Baby
